# iOS launch-screen images

These images belong to the iOS launch screen shown while the app starts. The
three PNGs provide the 1×, 2× and 3× variants listed in
[`Contents.json`](Contents.json).

To inspect or replace them, open `ios/Runner.xcworkspace` from the `frontend/`
directory on macOS, then choose **Runner → Assets.xcassets → LaunchImage** in
Xcode. Keep the filenames and scale entries consistent.

Application icons have a separate generated workflow. See the
[branding guide](../../../../../docs/arch/frontend/branding.md) before
changing app icon artwork.
